summary.title: Summary
summary.text: AWS-certified Cloud & DevOps Engineer, currently at Senior Sistemas. I work with cost optimization, architecture and decision-making, CI/CD pipelines, security, observability and production incident response, with a background in infrastructure support and software engineering.

items.role: Cloud & DevOps Engineer II - Senior Sistemas
bullets: Lead AWS cost optimization: in 2026, cloud costs were 52% below budget and 35% lower than in the same period of 2025.
Built an observability dashboard for the background job queues, key to finding the report generation bottleneck; after the fix, generation time dropped by up to 93%.
Lead critical incident response in production, with root cause analysis (RCA) and preventive measures.
Support cloud architecture decisions and work with development teams on observability and continuous delivery.

items.role: Cloud & DevOps Engineer I - Senior Sistemas
bullets: Led the application's stabilization after a critical production incident, tuning the ECS deploy strategy, health checks and application workers, which eliminated slowdowns and container crashes during deploys.
Started the AWS cost reduction effort, cutting the monthly cloud cost by 40% in the first three months.
Migrated repositories from Bitbucket to GitHub and rebuilt the CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
Implemented cloud security best practices, focusing on access management and resilience.
Developed and maintained scalable web applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, React.js, Next.js, Node, Tailwind CSS, Java, Python and PHP.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements and improve system performance.
Participated in code reviews, documentation and adoption of best practices for version control and CI.
Administration and monitoring of servers (Linux/Windows), including environment configuration and resource management.
Log analysis and incident diagnosis for efficient problem resolution.
Level 1/2 technical support, assisting clients via chat, ticket and email.
